stages.title: First Steps
stages.summary: Start with short, approachable outings and learn the essentials.
stages.advice: Choose a manageable route, pack the basics, stay with your group, and get comfortable turning back.

stages.title: Find Your Stride
stages.summary: Build confidence, endurance, and everyday trail skills.
stages.advice: Increase one challenge at a time. Practice pacing, offline navigation, weather awareness, and planning your return.

stages.title: Reach New Heights
stages.summary: Prepare for longer days, more climbing, and challenging terrain.
stages.advice: Assess the full route, elevation, exposure, daylight, and escape options. Build relevant skills before committing; fitness alone is not enough.

stages.title: Beyond the Trail
stages.summary: Explore backpacking, self-reliance, and helping others grow.
stages.advice: Learn overnight planning, water treatment, food storage, permits, and emergency decision-making. Seek qualified instruction for specialized terrain. Mentor with patience and respect for others’ limits.
